archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) with Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) influence

headings.usage: H1-H6, Hero text, Category Titles, Product Names

body.usage: Paragraphs, pricing, buttons, meta info, admin UI

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
layout_and_spacing.product_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-8 md:gap-12
layout_and_spacing.category_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix large spans (col-span-8) and small spans (col-span-4) for categories.
layout_and_spacing.admin_grid: Tight bento grid (gap-4 or gap-6) for dashboards. Use h-full for children.

components_strategy.header: Crystal Glass style: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F8F4EC]/80 border-b border-[#A8C3A0]/30. Links must be visible on desktop.
components_strategy.hero: Full bleed image. Overlay: max bg-black/40 or bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0F3D3E]/80 to-transparent. DO NOT obscure image completely.
components_strategy.product_card: Cardless design. Image wrapper with overflow-hidden, image scales slightly on hover. Text below image left-aligned. Playfair for title, Inter for price.
components_strategy.weight_toggle: Pill-shaped toggle (Piece vs Kilo) above Add to Cart button. Active: bg-[#0F3D3E] text-[#F8F4EC]. Inactive: bg-transparent border border-[#0F3D3E] text-[#0F3D3E].
components_strategy.cart_panel: Shadcn Sheet. Sliding from right. Clean layout, no unnecessary borders. Primary color for checkout CTA.
components_strategy.checkout_form: Shadcn Form/Input. Left-aligned labels. Use #F8F4EC background with solid white input fields and subtle #A8C3A0 borders.
components_strategy.admin_panel: Sidebar bg-[#0F3D3E] text-[#F8F4EC]. Main content bg-[#F8F4EC]. Use Shadcn Table, Dialog, Form for CRUD. Minimalist #FFFFFF card surfaces for data tables.
components_strategy.buttons: Primary CTA: bg-[#C9A063] text-white hover:bg-[#C9A063]/90 rounded-none w-full uppercase tracking-wider text-sm font-semibold transition-colors.

interactions_and_motion.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling if possible, or smooth CSS scroll behavior.
interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Product images: scale-105 duration-500 ease-out. Buttons: subtle background tint shift. Text links: explicitly set hover color.
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Use specific properties (e.g., transition-transform, transition-colors), avoid 'all'.

media_urls.description: Vibrant display of fresh vegetables, used for the main landing page hero section.
Red and yellow apple display, used for the Fruits category card.
Fresh green beans, used for the Vegetables category card.
Cozy deli/store showcase, used for the Services or About section background.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over #C9A063 meets minimum contrast. Use text shadow if needed.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Format: kebab-case, role-based (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for storefront layouts to ensure absolute creative freedom. Do not wrap everything in generic Card components.
Integrate Shadcn primitives (Sheet, Dialog, Form, Input, Table) for logic-heavy parts like Cart, Checkout, and Admin.
Strictly adhere to the provided color palette: #0F3D3E (Primary), #C9A063 (Secondary), #F8F4EC (Background), #A8C3A0 (Accent).
All copy MUST be in French.
Implement the piece/kilo weight selector logic dynamically. Updating the selection must adjust the price displayed and passed to the cart.
Stripe checkout must be fully functional.
Never use placeholder images; use the provided media_urls. If products lack images, fallback to the category or hero image.
Admin UI should be functional, dense, and clean. Differentiate it visually from the storefront by using standard grid structures and #FFFFFF card backgrounds.
